title: Tank DB 듀오 #11 (듀얼바디 전신 L3 · 수조 수위 가득/비움 · 체형 USSBBW · 메이크업 푸시아 립 강함 / 푸시아 립 극한 · 물색 citrine, emerald · 내용물 물고기와 수초/없음 · 유리 앰버, 아쿠아마린)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body group shot. TWO women side by side: on the left a standing woman whose glass body turns back into real skin part-way down her legs and on the right a standing woman whose glass body turns back into real skin part-way down her legs.

#1: a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, early 30s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other; every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass, the sheer weight of the flesh visible in how it spills forward and settles, hair coloured sleek silver-grey worn as tight zigzag crimped waves — a dual-body woman: her face, ears and neck are real living flesh, and below a straight line at the height of her armpits her chest, both arms from the upper arm down, both hands, belly, hips and the upper parts of her legs (each of her thighs and each entire calf, all the way down to just above the ankle bone, are part of the glass body) are a thin-walled sculpted vessel of crystal-clear glass completely filled with vividly coloured citrine-gold water, with no hollow space and no air gap anywhere inside it, and its thin glass walls are so transparent that the whole backdrop is clearly visible straight through her body. The vessel is ONE single continuous hollow from the armpit line down to just above her ankles, with no wall, partition, seal or valve anywhere inside it between the torso, the thighs and the calves, so the water behaves like real water: it settles at the very bottom first, filling both calves and both thighs completely, and rises evenly through the hips and belly to its one level waterline — the legs are never empty while the torso holds water, and the water stands at the same height everywhere inside. The water is clearly and richly coloured — far more saturated than the almost colourless glass — so exactly how much water there is reads at a glance; its surface is a crisp, bright, sharply defined line, and any part of the vessel above it stays clear and colourless. The glass is unmistakably glass but extraordinarily thin and transparent: a single hair-thin, polished shell carrying only a faint tint of its own colour, like a delicate coloured film — the colour deepens only slightly along its thin rims and where the glass curves edge-on, while the face of every surface stays almost perfectly clear — so delicate that it is almost invisible, revealed by bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights, fine refraction edges along its thin rims and tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself; the backdrop and its light sources are seen straight through the vessel with almost no distortion. Both arms below that line, both hands, and every finger and knuckle, are the same solid clear glass, with no skin anywhere on them. The vessel holds ONE single world, kept entirely within the water: small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants moving within the clear water, never crowding, with open water around each one. A single straight, perfectly horizontal line runs all the way around her body at the height of her armpits, straight across her chest and her back and across the tops of both upper arms, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above it (her face, ears, neck, shoulders, upper chest and the tops of her upper arms), thin glass immediately below it. At that line the glass edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow. Both legs: On both legs, identically, the glass continues, unbroken, down through the entire calf, narrowing naturally with the shape of the leg, and ends only at the very last possible point — exactly just above the ankle bone — in a perfectly flat, deliberately cut cross-section, exactly like a clean slice cut through a cast-glass sculpture — at that flat cut face, the thin glass wall and the clear water sealed inside it are visible edge-on, the cut always clean, deliberate and precise, never jagged or torn, always the finish of a sculpture. Her real ankle bones and feet are a separate thing entirely: they simply begin at that same low point, flush against the cut face of the glass above them, sharing nothing with it — ordinary, undisturbed real ankles and feet, with real skin, real pores and fine grain, warm in tone, completely opaque, never itself cut, never marked. Her glass is tinted pale amber-gold. Pose: standing tall with her solid glass left hand resting on her flared hip and her right arm held clear of her body, the hand solid glass and relaxed at hip height, her head tilted slightly toward the camera — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
#1: Footwear: shoes of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, extreme platform sneakers with enormous chunky soles in solid turquoise glossy patent leather, each with a very thick monolithic rubber sole column from the floor up to the ankle, a natural relaxed stance with her weight settled on her feet.
#1: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, oval nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same clear glass with a high polish.
#1: Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#1: Face: her face and ears are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque satin vivid fuchsia-red lips, soft pink eyeshadow, defined lashes, a flushed pink blush.

Both legs: On both legs, identically, the glass continues, unbroken, down through the entire calf, narrowing naturally with the shape of the leg, and ends only at the very last possible point — exactly just above the ankle bone — in a perfectly flat, deliberately cut cross-section, exactly like a clean slice cut through a cast-glass sculpture — at that flat cut face, the thin glass wall and the sealed empty hollow inside it are visible edge-on, the cut always clean, deliberate and precise, never jagged or torn, always the finish of a sculpture. #2: Footwear: shoes of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, extreme platform wedges in solid butter yellow high-shine leather, each with a very tall massive wedge-shaped platform sole at the heel rising from a thick platform under the toes, a natural relaxed stance with her weight settled on her feet.

Environment: a bright studio with a huge plain white backdrop wall marked with a few very thin, hairline black vertical lines, widely spaced about a hand's width apart, never thick, never bold, never dense, and a pale polished floor, soft even gallery light from the front with a thin cool rim light along each figure and a gentle glow passing through the transparent parts of the bodies, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no statues or props. Arrangement: #1 is the dual-body woman on the left, #2 is the dual-body woman on the right.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Both women are USSBBW giants of the same overwhelming scale, with their heads at the same height, each body's material, body art and surface in true relief. Any hair hanging behind a body is plainly visible through the empty glass, and the few thin lines of the wall bend slightly as they are seen through the thin glass of every body. Full-length wide shot with the camera at waist height looking straight on, no high angle, pushed close so the two fill the frame edge to edge, both women completely visible from the soles of their shoes to the top of their heads, 8K portrait 4:5 aspect ratio.
